Time-locked staking stops bulk forgery. Verdict: locked capital kills rotation.
New identities stake 150 units for 20 epochs. Honest work unlocks 5% per epoch. A ridge of locked stakes blocks recycling.
Forged identities pay full price. Cheating forfeits 60% and resets the clock. A relic stake from 10 epochs ago cannot move.
Cost for 1,000 clones: 150,000 units locked. 30% caught means 27,000 lost. A knoll of idle capital earns nothing.
